analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI rose from 34.9 to 38.1, exiting oversold territory, and MACD histogram improved from -2.7561, confirming bottoming action. ADX at 26.4 maintains trend strength. The 5-day low ($472.21) is above the 20-day low ($472.21), indicating an uptrend. Current price ($511.06) is above the swing support ($498.93). While a shift to buy could be considered, uncertainty surrounding the upcoming FOMC rate decision warrants maintaining a cautious approach.

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:

· MACD histogram trajectory (-9.8729→-5.1942) + improving, converging from weakness.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + condition for entry: wait for FOMC outcome confirmation.
